verses.text: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

segments.text: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah,
That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

verses.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

segments.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary,

verses.text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.

segments.text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion;
Even he that made heaven and earth.
